acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Table shows columns: Voucher #, Date, Type (voucher type/category - may be derived from description or voucher classification), Amount (total_debit/total_credit), Status (draft/posted/unposted), Entered by, Posted by, AR/AP entity (if applicable - deferred to Epic 4/5), Reversal badge, Attachment count.
Filters, query text, and sort order persist for each user/company session.
"Live" badges for count of draft vs posted vouchers.
Fuzzy/text/Unicode search on voucher number, description, supports Vietnamese terms.
Sort by multiple columns (e.g., date DESC + status).
Delete only allowed for unreferenced drafts, with mandatory reason captured in audit log.
Lazy loading/pagination (infinite scroll optional, MVP OK with page) with 20-50 items per page.
"No vouchers" state and UI guides users to create or adjust filters.
API error recovery: retry button, error details in toast/modal, printable JSON for support.
RBAC: non-admins see only their company's vouchers; user filters may be scoped by department/role if configured (department/role scoping deferred to post-MVP if not yet implemented).

constraints.constraint: Multi-tenancy: All vouchers must be company-scoped. Use CompanyScopedEntity interface pattern from Epic 1. All queries automatically filtered by company_id via CompanyContext.
Database schema: Follow PostgreSQL conventions: snake_case table names (vouchers), UUID primary keys, foreign keys with proper constraints.

Voucher number format: Auto-generated format VC{YYYY}-{seq} per tech spec. Implement thread-safe sequence generation (database-level sequence recommended for sequential numbering). Note: Voucher number generation will be implemented in Story 3.2 (voucher creation); this story only displays existing vouchers.
Status values: Enforce CHECK constraint for status values: 'draft', 'posted', 'unposted'. Status transitions handled in Story 3.2 (posting) and Story 3.3 (unposting/reversal).

Vietnamese search: Use PostgreSQL unaccent extension for unaccented search support (NFR23). Extension should already be enabled from Epic 2 Story 2.1 migration V8. Reuse unaccent_search() function pattern for voucher number and description search.
Pagination: Use Spring Data JPA Pageable interface. Default page size: 20-50 items. Support page and size query params.
Sorting: Support multi-column sorting via Spring Data JPA Sort interface. Sort params: sort=date,desc&sort=status,asc.
Filtering: Support date range (dateFrom, dateTo), status filter, search text. All filters must respect company context.
RBAC: All authenticated users (Accountant+) can view vouchers. Delete requires Accountant+ role. Company scoping enforced at API level via @PreAuthorize annotations.
Performance: Voucher list queries must use indexes (company_id, date, status). Target: < 2 seconds for initial render (NFR1). Use React Query caching (5-minute stale time).

Deletion validation: Only vouchers in 'draft' status can be deleted. Validate voucher is not referenced (no dependencies). Require deletion reason as query param or request body. Log deletion to audit trail with reason and user context.

Period dependency: Period entity and PeriodService from Epic 1 must be available for period_id foreign key relationship. Verify Epic 1 completion before implementing Voucher entity with @ManyToOne Period relationship.

Frontend dependency: @tanstack/react-query package must be added to frontend/package.json for caching and state management. Configure React Query with stale time (5 minutes) and background refetch as referenced in interfaces.
Backend packages: controller/voucher/ for Voucher controller, service/impl/voucher/ for service implementations.
Frontend pages: pages/VoucherList.tsx in pages directory. Components: components/voucher/ directory for voucher-related components.
Testing: Backend uses JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test with TestContainers for integration tests. Frontend uses Vitest + Testing Library + jsdom for component tests.

interfaces.interface: Returns paginated, filtered, sorted voucher list. Supports query params: page (page number), size (page size 20-50), status (filter by draft/posted/unposted), dateFrom/dateTo (date range filter), search (unaccented Vietnamese number/description search), sort (multi-column sorting).
Returns voucher counts by status: { draft: number, posted: number, unposted: number }. Filtered by company context automatically. Used for live badges in UI.

Deletes voucher if in 'draft' status and not referenced. Requires reason query param or request body. Logs deletion to audit trail. Returns 409 Conflict if posted/referenced, 403 Forbidden if no permission.
Returns paginated voucher list with filtering and sorting support. Filters by company context, status, date range, and search text. Supports multi-column sorting.
Searches vouchers by number or description with Vietnamese unaccented support using PostgreSQL unaccent extension. Filters by company context automatically.
Returns voucher counts by status (draft, posted, unposted) filtered by company context. Used for badge display in UI.
Deletes voucher with validation: must be in 'draft' status, must not be referenced, requires reason. Logs deletion to audit trail.

Main voucher list page component with MUI Data Grid integration, search input with debounced typeahead, filters (status, date range), multi-column sorting, pagination, live badges, and error recovery UI.
API service function for fetching paginated voucher list with query params support. Uses TanStack Query for caching and state management.
API service function for fetching voucher counts by status. Used for badge display.
API service function for deleting voucher with reason parameter. Handles error cases (409 Conflict, 403 Forbidden).

tests.standards: Backend testing uses JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test with TestContainers for integration tests. Service unit tests use Mockito for mocking dependencies. Frontend testing uses Vitest + Testing Library + jsdom for component tests. Integration tests verify full flows: load vouchers → search → filter → sort → delete draft voucher. Performance tests measure voucher list load time (< 2s target per NFR1) for 100+ vouchers. Accessibility tests verify keyboard navigation and screen reader support (WCAG AA compliance).

ideas.idea: Integration test: Create test vouchers with various statuses, verify table columns display correctly (Voucher #, Date, Type, Amount, Status, Entered by, Posted by), verify all columns are sortable, verify data formatting (dates, amounts).
Frontend component test: Test localStorage persistence for filters, search text, and sort order. Verify persistence is per user/company combination. Test persistence across page refreshes.

Integration test: Create vouchers with different statuses, call GET /api/v1/vouchers/counts, verify counts match actual voucher counts by status. Verify counts update in real-time when vouchers are created/updated.

Integration test: Create vouchers with Vietnamese descriptions (with accents), search with unaccented terms (e.g., "nha" matches "nhà"), verify search works for voucher numbers and descriptions. Test Unicode support.
Integration test: Call GET /api/v1/vouchers with multiple sort params (sort=date,desc&sort=status,asc), verify results are sorted correctly by multiple columns. Test all sortable columns.

Integration test: Attempt to delete posted voucher, verify 409 Conflict response. Attempt to delete referenced draft voucher, verify 409 Conflict response. Delete unreferenced draft voucher with reason, verify success and audit log entry created with reason.
Integration test: Load voucher list with 100+ vouchers, verify pagination works (page, size params), verify performance (< 2s target). Test with various page sizes (20, 50).
Frontend component test: Render VoucherList with no vouchers, verify empty state displays guidance to create or adjust filters. Test empty state with filters applied vs no filters.
Frontend component test: Simulate API error, verify retry button appears, verify error details shown in toast/modal, verify printable JSON for support. Test error recovery flow.

Integration test: Create vouchers for Company A and Company B, login as user from Company A, verify only Company A vouchers are visible. Test RBAC enforcement with different user roles (Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO).
